svg.title: Interactive order-3 normal magic hexagon
svg.desc: Numbers 1 through 19 form the unique normal magic hexagon of order 3. Hover with a mouse, focus with a keyboard, or tap a cell to highlight the three straight lines through it. Every such line sums to 38.
svg.metadata: Number placement follows Wikimedia Commons “MagicHexagon-Order3-a.svg” by Atropos235, licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 / CC BY-SA 2.5 / GFDL 1.2. This interactive redraw adds responsive styling and interaction. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MagicHexagon-Order3-a.svg
